caption: The drawing depicts a long, wide-sleeved garment with a high neckline, shown from the back. The main part of the dress is outlined in fine black lines on a light, off-white background. The yoke and sleeve cuffs feature vertically oriented rectangular panels decorated with blue and black linework patterns. There is a gathered detail just below the yoke, suggesting fabric is drawn together there. Around the bottom hem of the dress, there is a double-layered ruffle with parallel lines indicating pleats or gathers. Two rectangular insets appear to the left and right of the garment: the left inset shows a detailed pattern with lace-like elements, and the right inset displays an oval emblem or medallion inside a square with detailed linework. The entire composition is monochromatic except for the blue elements in the yoke and cuffs.
title: Nightgown
